hero.eyebrow: Product page audits for apparel stores
hero.title: See how your shirt ranks against similar shirts
hero.sub: Paste a product link or a draft listing. We read it, rank it among comparable shirts from real stores, and tell you the 3 things to fix first. Free, no sign-up.
hero.pasteToggle: Not published yet? Check a draft listing
hero.urlToggle: Check a live product link instead
hero.p1.d: Each fact we show comes with the exact text we found on your page.
hero.p2.d: Checked against {n} apparel products from real stores in our dataset.
hero.p3.d: We tell you what we know, what is a hypothesis, and what we can't know yet.
hero.invalidUrl: Enter a full link starting with http:// or https://
err.title: We couldn't audit this page
err.robots: This store's robots.txt asks crawlers not to read this page, so we didn't. You can check it as a draft listing instead.
err.notProduct: This doesn't look like a product page. We couldn't find a product name, price or product type. Try the link of a single product.
err.dns: We couldn't reach that website. Check the link for typos.
err.scheme: Only http:// and https:// links can be audited.
err.private: That link points to a private network address, so we can't open it.
err.timeout: The store took too long to respond. Try again in a minute.
err.tooBig: That page is larger than we can read (3 MB).
err.upstream: The store answered with an error ({detail}). Check that the page opens in your browser.
err.network: We couldn't reach ProductLens. Check your connection and try again.
res.headline: 3 things to fix first
res.headline0.d: Your page states the facts most similar products state. Keep it accurate and check back after you change it.
res.sentence: We found {facts} of {of} key facts on your page. The top-ranked similar shirts state {median}.
res.sentenceNoPeers: We found {facts} of {of} key facts on your page. We found no similar products to compare with yet.
res.trust: Ranked among {peers} comparable shirts in our dataset by listing completeness. We have not tested AI assistants for your product yet, and we can't promise any change in rankings or sales.
res.planSub: Ordered by how many similar products already do this. Tick items off as you go.
act.missing_attribute.t: Add {label}, if you can verify it
act.missing_attribute.w: We couldn't find {label} on your page. {c} of the {n} top-ranked similar shirts state it.
act.description.t: Describe the product in more detail, with facts you can verify
act.description.w: Your description is {t} characters. The top-ranked similar shirts have {m}. Length alone is not the goal: add concrete facts shoppers ask about.
act.structured_data.t: Add {what} markup that matches your visible page
act.structured_data.w: We found no {what} markup on your page. {c} of the {n} top-ranked similar shirts have it.
act.structured_data.w0: We found no {what} markup on your page.
act.price.t: Check your price is correct and the page explains it
act.price.w: Your price of {price} is {pos} the middle half of {n} comparable listings ({lo} to {hi}). This is positioning evidence, not a recommended price.
act.language.w: We couldn't detect the page language, so we can't compare you with products in your language.
seo.safe: Adds information only. Your URL and title stay the same.
seo.markup: Machine-readable markup only. Your visible page and URL stay the same.
seo.price: No page change needed unless you decide to change the price.
found.title: What we found on your page
found.sub: Did we read your product correctly?
found.saved: Noted. Update your page so shoppers and AI see it too.
found.localNote: Your confirmations stay in this browser for now.
found.none: We couldn't read any structured facts from this page.
notfound.title: Not found on your page
notfound.sub: We couldn't find these. That doesn't mean your product lacks them; they may be missing from the page or shown only in images.
notfound.peers: {c} of the {n} top-ranked similar shirts state it
notfound.predictedNote: Model guess, not from your page. Confirm only if true.
compare.title: How you compare
price.title: Price position
price.range: Middle half of {n} comparable listings: {lo} to {hi}
price.note: Evidence for positioning, not a recommended price.
peers.title: Similar products
peers.sub: Same product type and language, similar price.
peers.none: No similar products in our dataset yet. As the dataset grows, this list fills in.
vis.title: AI visibility
vis.empty: Not live yet. AI assistant checks run after our benchmark; we will show real answers here, never estimates.
unk.title: What we can't know yet
unk.1: Whether AI assistants like ChatGPT or Claude recommend your product. We have not run those checks for you yet.
unk.2: Whether any change will affect your search ranking, traffic or sales. We suggest changes based on what similar products show, not proven effects.
unk.3: Facts that appear only in images or load after the page opens. We mark these as not found, not as missing.
unk.fewPeers: We found only {n} similar products, so comparisons are weak.
mon.title: Monitor this product
mon.sub: We re-check the page on a schedule and show what changed. No billing yet.
mon.ok: Monitoring started. See it in My products.
mon.exists: Already monitored. See it in My products.
bulk.title: Bulk audit
bulk.sub: For agencies and multi-store teams. Paste up to 20 product links, one per line. We audit them one at a time.
bulk.tooMany: Only the first 20 links will be audited.
bulk.reportNote: Findings compare each page with similar products in our dataset. They are not predictions of ranking or sales.
prod.title: My products
prod.empty: No products monitored yet. Audit a product and choose Monitor this product.
prod.confirm: Stop monitoring this product? Past snapshots are kept.
hist.title: Change history
hist.empty: No changes detected yet. We compare each new snapshot with the previous one.
footer: ProductLens compares your page with real products. It never invents facts about your product.
hero.draftTitlePh: e.g. Heavyweight organic cotton tee, black
hero.draftTextPh: Everything you plan to write: materials, fabric weight, fit, sizes, colours, care
hero.emptyTitle: Add a title for your shirt.
hero.p2.d0: Checked against apparel products from real stores in our dataset.
rank.aloneD: We found no shirts of the same type, language and price range in our dataset, so we can't rank this one yet.
act.readable.w: We couldn't read {label} from your page's text or markup. Shoppers may see it, but tools and AI assistants may not. {c} of the {n} top-ranked similar shirts expose it.
price.noPrice: We couldn't read a price and currency from your page, so we can't place it among similar shirts yet.
price.fewPeers: Fewer than 3 comparable shirts have a price in your currency, so we can't place your price yet.
rank.formula: Listing quality = {wf} × (key facts stated ÷ 23) + {wd} × (description length ÷ {ref} characters, capped at 1){sd}. We compare you only with shirts of the same type and language in a similar price range. This is not a search or AI ranking.
rank.factsTip: How many of the 23 facts shoppers look for (material, fit, sizes, colours...) your page states. Worth up to {w} points.
rank.descTip: Description length compared with the typical comparable shirt ({ref} characters). Full points at or above it. Worth up to {w} points.
rank.sdTip: Whether the page has schema.org Product and Offer markup that search engines and AI tools can read. Worth up to {w} points.
rank.aiNote: This ranks how complete your listing is. An AI-visibility rank comes after our benchmark runs.
rank.boardSub: Comparable shirts ordered by listing quality.
table.title: Side by side with the top-ranked products
table.sub: Only facts at least one of these shirts states. Scroll sideways on small screens.
draft.note: Draft listing: we checked your text only. Structured data is added when you publish, so it isn't scored.
mod.title: Model comparison
mod.sub: Which model reads shirt pages most accurately? Every model gets the same held-out products and the same prompt.
mod.emptyD: We publish numbers here only after the evaluation run finishes. Nothing on this page is estimated.
mod.sample: Sample data for testing the page. These are not measured results.
mod.headline: {m} gets the most filled-in fields right: {p} of non-empty fields on {n} held-out products.
mod.headlineNoN: {m} gets the most filled-in fields right: {p} of non-empty fields.
mod.nonnullTip: Of the fields that have a value in the checked answer, the share the model got exactly right. This is the main score.
mod.nullTip: Of the fields with no value on the page, the share the model correctly left empty instead of guessing.
mod.byLangSub: Filled fields correct, per language of the product page.
mod.fieldsSub: Exact-match accuracy per field. The best model in each row is highlighted.
mod.newFieldsSub: Fields added to the training data in TEAM-37; fewer examples, so expect more noise.
mod.m1: Same held-out products for every model ({s}).
mod.m1NoN: Same held-out products for every model.
mod.m2: Same prompt and the same JSON output format for every model.
mod.m3: Scoring: a field counts as correct only if it exactly matches the checked answer. A missing key or invalid JSON counts as wrong.
mod.m4: The all-null baseline answers "empty" for every field. It shows how much of the score comes from leaving fields empty.
mod.c1: The test set is small, so differences of a few points may be noise.
mod.c2: Version 1 of the fine-tuned model was trained on text that still contained escaped HTML, which can lower its scores.
mod.c3: Costs come from the run file; local models are shown without hardware costs.
mod.settings: Model settings from the run file
ob.title: Set up your merchant profile
ob.sub: Three short steps. Everything you enter is stored as merchant-stated; we never present it as verified.
ob.name: Your name
ob.about: Tell us about yourself and your business
ob.aboutPh: What you do, how long you've been selling, what you want to improve.
ob.claimsHint: One per line. Stored as merchant-stated; we do not verify them.
ob.manualHint: Manual details are labelled merchant-stated and audited as a draft.
ob.badUrl: This is not a full http(s) link: {url}
ob.tokenSub: This key signs you in on this and other devices and in the browser extension. We only store a hash of it.
ob.tokenWarn: It is shown only once. Copy it somewhere safe; we cannot recover it.
home.signupTitle: Track all your products in one report
home.signupSub: Create a free merchant profile: add your products, get a printable report and suggested text you approve.
share.title: Share link
share.sub: Optional. Anyone with the link can view the report (company name, website and product audits only; no personal details). Not indexed by search engines. Revoke any time.
share.gone: This link does not exist or was revoked.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.short: We store only what you enter here and your audit results. No tracking, no email required. You can delete everything at any time.
privacy.body: We store your profile, products and audit results, linked to a hashed key. Nothing is sold or published. Delete removes all of it, including any share link.
rep.method: Listing quality ranks page completeness among comparable shirts in our dataset. It is not a search or AI-visibility rank.
rep.notAudited: Not audited yet. Run the audit from your dashboard.
rep.priceAt: {price}, {pos} the middle range of {n} comparable listings
sug.title: Suggested text
sug.note: Built only from facts found on your page. Nothing is published: accept copies the text for you to paste in your store.
sug.orig.title: Current title
sug.new.title: Suggested title
rep.noPeersLong: No comparable products in the dataset (same type, language and price band), so there is no rank or fix list yet.
chat.sub: Questions about your audited products, answered from your own audit data.
chat.honest: Answers are built by fixed rules from the audits stored in your profile. No AI model is used and nothing is sent anywhere; if the data doesn't answer a question, we say so.
chat.start: Pick a question below or type your own.
chat.placeholder: Ask about fixes, prices, missing facts, ranks...
chat.needProfile: Ask needs your stored audits. Create a profile and audit your products first.
chat.noAudits: None of your products is audited yet, so there is nothing to answer from.
chat.fix: The first fix for each of your lowest-scoring products:
chat.price: Your prices against comparable listings (positioning evidence, not a recommended price):
chat.missing: Facts we most often could not find, across {n} audited products:
chat.rank: Listing quality across your audited products:
chat.suggest: Open your report and press Suggest on a product. We draft a title and description only from facts found on the page; you accept or dismiss each one and nothing is published.
chat.help: I can answer from your audits about: what to fix first, prices, missing facts, best and worst products, and AI visibility.
chat.q.rank: Which product ranks best and worst?
chat.q.vis: Am I visible in AI assistants?
kb.title: Keyboard shortcuts
land.title: Know what your product page is missing before shoppers do.
land.sub: ProductLens reads your apparel product page, compares it with similar products from real stores and gives you a ranked list of fixes, with the evidence for each one.
land.free: Single audits are free and need no account. A profile adds your catalogue, reports and share links.
land.sheet.note: Illustration of the checklist. Your audit shows only what we actually find on your page.
land.features: Built for the people who run the store
land.featuresSub: Everything is tied to evidence from your page or from comparable products.
land.f.audit.d: 23 facts shoppers look for, each with the exact text we found.
land.f.rank.d: A transparent listing-quality score and where you sit among comparable products.
land.f.plan.d: What most top-ranked products state that yours doesn't, in order.
land.f.suggest.d: Titles and descriptions built only from verified facts. Never published for you.
land.f.report.d: Every product in one printable report, CSV export and an optional private share link.
land.f.ext.d: Audit the page you're on and save it to your report.
land.how.1.d: Or a draft listing that isn't published yet.
land.how.2.d: Facts from your page against comparable products from real stores.
land.how.3.d: Tick off the plan and re-check when you've updated the page.
land.honest.1: "Not found on the page" never means your product lacks it.
land.honest.2: We never claim a change will lift search or AI ranking.
land.honest.3: What you tell us is labelled merchant-stated, not verified.
land.honest.4: AI visibility is shown only when it has been measured.
ov.pendingSub: Audit them to fill your report.
ov.noAuditsBody: Add a product link and we'll audit it.
pr.sub: Your catalogue with audits, and pages you monitor for changes.
pr.signupTitle: Create a profile to keep a catalogue
pr.note: Audits are stored in your profile.
privacy.typeName: Type {name} to confirm. This removes the profile, products, audits and share link and cannot be undone.
res.allDone: All done. Re-audit after you update the page.
set.keyBody: We only store a hash of your key, so we can't show it again. Keep your copy safe; anyone with it can open this profile.
set.extBody: Paste the same key in the extension's settings to save pages to your report.
si.title: Sign in with your access key
si.sub: Paste the key shown when the profile was created. It is kept in this browser only.
table.gaps: {n} facts that comparable products state and yours doesn't are highlighted.
ws.emptyBody: Paste a link on the left, or start with one of these real product pages.
ws.middleHalf: vs the middle half of comparable prices
ws.saved: Saved and audited in your catalogue.
ws.visAvail: AI visibility has been measured for the benchmark set; product-level results appear here when your product is included.
pd.notFound: This product is not in the active company's catalogue.
pd.sample: Sample data: the snapshot, trend and product-chat services are not connected yet, so this page shows an invented example to preview the layout. None of it describes your product.
pd.onePoint: One check so far; a trend needs two.
pd.noFieldChanges: No fact changed between these snapshots.
pd.needTwoBody: Each re-audit or scheduled re-check adds a snapshot.
pd.chatHint: Answers come only from stored snapshots, change events, trends and audits, with a citation for every sentence. Unsupported sentences are dropped.
pd.chatQ: What changed and what's required now?
err.notShirt: This doesn't look like a shirt, so it wasn't ranked. PowerLens compares shirts (t-shirts, polos, shirts) only. If it is a shirt, name the type in the title.
err.rateLimited: This store is limiting automated requests right now. Try again in a minute, or paste the product title and description below.
hero.draftDetailsPh: Care, fit notes, size chart, product link
draft.unknownType: We couldn't tell the product type from your title or description, so there are no comparable shirts to rank against. Name the type (e.g. t-shirt, polo) in the title.
pd.noToken: No access to this product's history on this device
pd.noTokenBody: History is protected by the manage key saved in the browser that started monitoring. Open it there, or start monitoring again from My products.
pd.rankNote: Rank is by attribute completeness against comparable products in the dataset, recomputed per snapshot. It is not a search or AI rank.
pd.noText: Text not stored for these snapshots; only the length changed is known.
